text:
Alex M: heads up — planning to toggle the multi-region failover routing flag for the eu->us fallback path tomorrow morning. need consensus on canary audience + guardrails. details below.

Maya S: +1. what are you thinking for the canary slice? percent and duration? :eyes:

Alex M: starting suggestion: 5% of eu traffic, 30m ramp, then 25% for 2h, then full. keep stickiness so sessions stay on their assigned route for 1h.

Samir K: curious about model fallback ordering — do we fallback region first or model size variant? order matters for cost/SLOs.

Alex M: prefer region-first (same model family in us-west) then smaller/quantized model if region fallback exhausted. that keeps quality predictable.

Liam R: infra note: us-west pool has capacity for extra burst ~2000 rps if we limit to 25% during canary. autoscale policies good, but watch prewarming.

Priya G: please add monitoring hooks: per-route p50/p95, error rate, token cost estimate, and a prompt-regression alert linked to eval set. gate: if p95 latency > 800ms or errors > 0.5% abort.

Alex M: agreed. will add the two automatic abort gates. also plan to enable KV-prefix cache TTL 15s for EU->US routes to avoid cold starts.

Samir K: can you paste the flag config you plan to push? makes it easier for code-review.

Alex M: here's a minimal flag snippet: 
```json
{
  "flag": "geo.failover.eu_to_us",
  "canary": { "percent": 5, "duration_min": 30 },
  "stages": [
    {"percent": 5, "duration_min": 30},
    {"percent": 25, "duration_min": 120},
    {"percent": 100, "duration_min": 0}
  ],
  "stickiness_minutes": 60,
  "fallback_order": ["region:us-west","model:quantized-small"],
  "abort_gates": {"p95_ms": 800, "error_rate_pct": 0.5}
}
```

Maya S: looks good. please add a `trace_id` prefix so we can filter logs for the canary flows. e.g., `geo-failover-canary-1765`.

Alex M: will add trace_id and a per-canary log tag. also plan to route diagnostics to a short retention query dataset for the 4h window.

Liam R: quick ask — toggle open window for manual rollback? operationally we should keep a rollback runbook pinned. I can add a one-click rollback button in the console for this flag.

Priya G: add a post-deploy smoke that hits a sample prompt set from eu and checks top-k token diffs < 3%. if exceeded fail gate.

Samir K: one more — ensure routing stickiness respects session affinity for multi-turn chats (kv cache mapping). otherwise we'll see broken contexts.

Alex M: yes stickiness will use session_id -> route mapping and honor KV cache TTL.

oncall-bot: reminder — schedule a 30m watch channel for the rollout: #eng-platform-watch at 09:30 UTC. create incident stub if abort gate triggers.

Maya S: I'll be on watch. tagging @Priya G and @Liam R for the 09:30 slot. :thumbsup:

Alex M: thanks all. I'll open the PR now with the flag + runbook + smoke tests. ping here once PR is merged and when the flag is advanced to 25%.
_notes: Thread about coordination for a multi-region failover feature flag — canary plan, guardrails, stickiness, monitoring and runbook. Contains a JSON snippet for the proposed flag config. Messages are concise and in Slack style.
